t: This is the site of the AIDS Memorial in London, a public artwork to honour people affected by HIV and AIDS in the United Kingdom. It isn't finished yet. It is due to be completed in late 2027, so what you see today is a place waiting for it. The memorial will be designed by Anya Gallaccio, a Scottish artist born in 1963, who makes site-specific, minimalist installations and often works with organic matter. That gives some sense of the kind of work to expect here.
